board derives a status for every issue from what trunk and every branch say
about it, and groups them.

Nothing here is stored. An issue file carries a state, which is one ref's claim
about one issue; a status is what the repository as a whole says.

Usage:
  isu board [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for board

Global Flags:
      --fetch         update remote refs before reading
      --json          print newline-delimited JSON instead of text
      --no-color      never colour the output
      --ref string    the ref isu treats as trunk (default: main, else master, else HEAD)
      --repo string   the repository to read (default: the working directory)
